name: web3d-dev
description: Realtime 3D on the web in three skills: run the scene, ship the assets, move the characters.

plugins.name: web3d-dev
plugins.description: Three skills for realtime 3D on the web: the three.js WebGPU runtime with TSL, compute, post-processing and a WebGL2 fallback; the glTF asset pipeline from source to frame, with compression, budgets, sourcing and optional Asset Foundry ordering; and a 3D animation protocol covering rigs, clip conventions, blending, GPU and instanced animation, and reduced motion. Every API fact is pinned to a verified three.js release.
